headline: US Tech Stocks Fall on AI Policy Concerns Following Midterm Elections
summary: Technology shares fell as investors weighed potential delays to the artificial intelligence build-out under a Democrat-controlled Congress, reversing parts of the post-election Wall Street rally.
why: Mega-cap technology companies have driven broader equity returns, making sentiment on AI infrastructure spending central to global market trends.

impacts.name: Nasdaq Composite
impacts.why: Tech equities retreated over concerns that a Democrat-led Congress could slow down AI infrastructure development.
